items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: the best snare drum player in all of them in the street was old man Cottrell. Man, that's who he used to play with, Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: No, I don't remember anything. Now, but the best snare drum player in all of them in the street was old man Cottrell. Man, that's who he used to play with, Manuel Perez. That's where I saw him, old man Cottrell, old man Lutz Cottrell. 된 stuff with
In the Perez, I wouldn't say as far back as where the men and then, but I mean they still had fellas playing, you know, running times. Or anything you'd say like Howard, he was playing.
